title: Có xe đưa đón giữa các nhà ga không?
englishTitle: Is there a shuttle between terminals?
pronunciation: Co xe dua don giua cac nha ga khong
summary: For checking whether airport terminals are connected by shuttle before walking the wrong way.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Ask before leaving the arrivals hall, baggage area, or check-in zone for another terminal.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the terminal number, boarding pass, or flight screen. The answer may be shuttle, walkway, or taxi.

phrases.vietnamese: Có xe đưa đón giữa các nhà ga không?
phrases.english: Is there a shuttle between terminals?
phrases.pronunciation: Co xe dua don giua cac nha ga khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Có asks is there; xe đưa đón means shuttle; giữa các nhà ga means between terminals.

breakdown.vietnamese: Có xe đưa đón giữa các nhà ga không?
breakdown.english: Is there a shuttle between terminals?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: If the route changes, move to terminal, departure hall, information desk, or shuttle-between-terminals follow-ups.

phrases.english: Where can I buy a SIM card?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good after landing, during a transfer, or when domestic and international terminal signs are not obvious.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Some airport transfers are close; others need a bus, taxi, or staff direction. Confirm before you start walking.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Use pickup-area, driver, baggage, terminal, or information-desk cards if the transfer has another detail.
